files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A contact section: a form (name, email, subject, message, consent) and, in the split layout, the ways to reach
  us beside it. Axes: layout (single, split), fields (short: email and message, full), terms (show, hide), tone
  (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ContactLabels } from "./contact-form.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type ContactFormProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  labels: ContactLabels;
  details: Feature[];
  layout?: "single" | "split";
  fields?: "short" | "full";
  terms?: "show" | "hide";
  level?: 1 | 2;
  page?: "section" | "full";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Checkbox from "../compose/Checkbox.vue";
import Form from "../compose/Form.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Input from "../compose/Input.vue";
import Label from "../compose/Label.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Textarea from "../compose/Textarea.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  labels,
  details,
  layout = "single",
  fields = "full",
  terms = "hide",
  level = 2,
  page = "section",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ContactFormProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="text"
    :heading="{ level }"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="(((page as string) === 'full') ? 'roomy' : 'default')"
    :align="(((page as string) === 'full') ? 'center' : 'start')"
    :measure="(((layout as string) === 'single') ? 'xl' : 'default')"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Grid :cols="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? '1-2' : '1')" class="items-start gap-8">
      <Form method="dialog" class="w-full gap-4" data-testid="contact-form">
        <Field v-if="((fields as string) === 'full')" :label="labels.name" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-name', id)">
          <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" :id="tpl('{0}-name', id)" data-testid="field" />
        </Field>
        <Field :label="labels.email" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-email', id)">
          <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-testid="field" />
        </Field>
        <Field v-if="((fields as string) === 'full')" :label="labels.subject" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-subject', id)">
          <Input type="text" name="subject" :id="tpl('{0}-subject', id)" data-testid="field" />
        </Field>
        <Field :label="labels.message" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-message', id)">
          <Textarea :rows="4" name="message" :id="tpl('{0}-message', id)" data-testid="field" />
        </Field>
        <Group v-if="((terms as string) === 'show')" gap="2" align="center" :class="cn('w-fit', '')">
          <Checkbox name="consent" :id="tpl('{0}-consent', id)" />
          <Label :for="tpl('{0}-consent', id)" class="text-sm">
            {{ labels.consent }}
          </Label>
        </Group>
        <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" class="w-fit" data-testid="submit">
          {{ labels.submit }}
        </Button>
      </Form>
      <Stack
        v-if="(((layout as string) === 'split') && ((details?.length ?? 0) > 0))"
        gap="4"
        data-testid="details"
      >
        <Group v-for="d in details" :key="d.id" gap="4" align="start" data-testid="detail">
          <LucideIcon :name="d.icon" :size="20" />
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ d.title }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ d.text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
